caption: The drawing features a single wooden cradle depicted in an isometric perspective, occupying the central area of the image. The cradle is rectangular with slightly curved rockers at the base, allowing it to rock back and forth. The front panel has a gentle concave curve at the top, while the sides extend upwards and join a canopy-like structure that partially covers the head end of the cradle. The drawing uses shades of brown and gray, with fine lines and cross-hatching to simulate the wood texture and provide shading, giving depth and a three-dimensional appearance. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details, emphasizing the cradle as the single focus.
title: Cradle
